# ATG Tickets

> > Official ticketing platform for Ambassador Theatre Group venues, offering West End musicals, plays, and live entertainment across London and the UK

ATG Tickets is the primary booking service for ATG (Ambassador Theatre Group) theatres, including iconic West End venues like the Phoenix Theatre and Kit Kat Club at the Playhouse, as well as regional theatres such as Grand Opera House York, Granville Theatre, and Rhoda McGaw Theatre Woking. The platform features major productions including Cabaret, Stranger Things: The First Shadow, Bluey's Big Play, and Spring Awakening.
